record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>and<Fi> Song<WH07892> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Praise<WH08416> waiteth<WH01747> for thee, O God<WH0430>, in Sion<WH06726>: and unto thee shall the vow<WH05088> be performed<WH07999><WTH8792>. <RF>waiteth: Heb. is silent<Rf>
O thou that hearest<WH08085><WTH8802> prayer<WH08605>, unto thee shall all flesh<WH01320> come<WH0935><WTH8799>.

Iniquities<WH01697><WH05771> prevail<WH01396><WTH8804> against me: <FI>as for<Fi> our transgressions<WH06588>, thou shalt purge them away<WH03722><WTH8762>. <RF>iniquities: Heb. Words, or, Matters of iniquities<Rf>

Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is the man whom<Fi> thou choosest<WH0977><WTH8799>, and causest to approach<WH07126><WTH8762> <FI>unto thee, that<Fi> he may dwell<WH07931><WTH8799> in thy courts<WH02691>: we shall be satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799> with the goodness<WH02898> of thy house<WH01004>, <FI>even<Fi> of thy holy<WH06918> temple<WH01964>.

<FI> By<Fi> terrible things<WH03372><WTH8737> in righteousness<WH06664> wilt thou answer<WH06030><WTH8799> us, O God<WH0430> of our salvation<WH03468>; <FI>who art<Fi> the confidence<WH04009> of all the ends<WH07099> of the earth<WH0776>, and of them that are afar off<WH07350> <FI>upon<Fi> the sea<WH03220>:<CM>
Which by his strength<WH03581> setteth fast<WH03559><WTH8688> the mountains<WH02022>; <FI>being<Fi> girded<WH0247><WTH8737> with power<WH01369>:
Which stilleth<WH07623><WTH8688> the noise<WH07588> of the seas<WH03220>, the noise<WH07588> of their waves<WH01530>, and the tumult<WH01995> of the people<WH03816>.

They also that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in the uttermost parts<WH07099> are afraid<WH03372><WTH8799> at thy tokens<WH0226>: thou makest the outgoings<WH04161> of the morning<WH01242> and evening<WH06153> to rejoice<WH07442><WTH8686>. <RF>rejoice: or, sing<Rf>

Thou visitest<WH06485><WTH8804> the earth<WH0776>, and waterest<WH07783><WTH8787> it: thou greatly<WH07227> enrichest<WH06238><WTH8686> it with the river<WH06388> of God<WH0430>, <FI>which<Fi> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of water<WH04325>: thou preparest<WH03559><WTH8686> them corn<WH01715>, when thou hast so provided<WH03559><WTH8686> for it. <RF>and...: or, after thou hadst made it to desire rain<Rf>

Thou waterest<WH07301><WH00> the ridges<WH08525> thereof abundantly<WH07301><WTH8761>: thou settlest<WH05181><WTH8763> the furrows<WH01417><WTH8676><WH01418> thereof: thou makest it soft<WH04127><WTH8787> with showers<WH07241>: thou blessest<WH01288><WTH8762> the springing<WH06780> thereof. <RF>settlest: or, causest rain to descend into<Rf> <RF>makest...: Heb. dissolvest it<Rf>
Thou crownest<WH05849><WTH8765> the year<WH08141> with thy goodness<WH02896>; and thy paths<WH04570> drop<WH07491><WTH8799> fatness<WH01880>. <RF>with: Heb. of<Rf>

They drop<WH07491><WTH8799> <FI>upon<Fi> the pastures<WH04999> of the wilderness<WH04057>: and the little hills<WH01389> rejoice<WH01524> on every side<WH02296><WTH8799>. <RF>rejoice...: Heb. are girded with joy<Rf>

The pastures<WH03733> are clothed<WH03847><WTH8804> with flocks<WH06629>; the valleys<WH06010> also are covered over<WH05848><WTH8799> with corn<WH01250>; they shout for joy<WH07321><WTH8709>, they also sing<WH07891><WTH8799>.<CM>
